headline: Optiemus Infracom Limited: Acquisition & Loan
sum: Optiemus Infracom informed the NSE of an acquisition involving BIG Tech and a loan facility to GDN, but core transaction values and structure remain unconfirmed in publicly available sources.
detail: On 30 June 2026, Optiemus Infracom Limited filed an NSE intimation (OILSE Intimation for Investment in BIG Tech and Loan to GDN) announcing an acquisition. The filing references both an investment in BIG Tech and a loan to GDN, but public sources do not yet disclose the transaction value, completion date, conditions, or law firm advisors.
